text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here we are at the Takarazuka Kinen!
The spring festival where Umamusume chosen by the fan vote gather!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Especially this year! An unprecedented, star-studded lineup has gathered. First up is...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Symboli Kris S. A professional of the Symboli household who never fails to take down her target.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Neo Universe. The Double Crown Umamusume who conquered the Satsuki Sho and Tokyo Yushun makes a surprise entry while still in the Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe……
wants to "capture" this place too.
――It's "SISR."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Agnes Digital.
The turf-or-dirt all-rounder makes her grand entrance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, dignified isn't the word for it!
I'm just sniffing up the preciousness of Umamusume
and running, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And there's the much-anticipated Tap Dance City
and Hishi Miracle.
The rest of the field is full of exceptional talent as well.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Heh... Now that's what I call an interesting coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Tap-chan? What do you mean by coincidence...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"This Takarazuka Kinen is my stepping stone to the world.
And fittingly—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It means Umamusume with international flair have gathered here!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: First, it goes without saying that Kris S is an Umamusume who came from America.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is a powerhouse rumored
to be taking on overseas challenges in the near future, too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And Agnes Digital is a traveler
with experience running in Dubai and Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of 'em's
reaking with the scent of the world stage!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that so...
That's kinda shocking~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm the only one who's never even thought about going overseas~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, in that case,
you better start aiming for it today too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, if I win among this lineup,
my world conquest will be one step closer!

Come to think of it... that lineup looked
almost as if it was meant to prepare for an overseas challenge.

"If she can win here, she certainly has the ability.
However, the problem is..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Tap Dance City...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yo, fellow countrywoman. And a horse girl
sailing a completely different course from mine.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You know, right?
You know who our target is today?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, it's me, only me!
I'm the only one who can defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Keep a tight mark on her.
Take your eyes off her for even a second—and it's The End.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――I know.
However, the one I am aiming for... is not you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Lies ahead of you—victory.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hah, that's the spirit!
Then go rip it away from them, Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If I can't beat you,
there's no way I can win against the world.
Now, let's set sail for our maiden naval battle!
